title: In all the controversy over “religious liberty” –
excerpt: Do you think laws that regulate snake-handling will become a cause for outrage? Here’s the latest story on the subject … http://www.washingtonpost.com/lifestyle/style/serpent-handling-pastor-profiled-earlier-in-washington-post-dies-from-rattlesnake-bite/2012/05/29/gJQAJef5zU_s…
body:
Do you think laws that regulate snake-handling will become a cause for outrage? Here’s the latest story on the subject …

 http://www.washingtonpost.com/lifestyle/style/serpent-handling-pastor-profiled-earlier-in-washington-post-dies-from-rattlesnake-bite/2012/05/29/gJQAJef5zU_story.html

At what point does the public good require the state to limit “religious freedom?” How would we feel if children were present when rattlers and copperheads were brought out? How far is too far – for the state, and for the church?
